hook_text: Half the circuits in the room will not light first time. Here is how to find the gap in under a minute.
clip_script: Battery, switch, lamp, one loop. Any gap and it is dark. Lamp dead? Touch it straight to the battery. Lights? Then the battery and lamp are fine. Swap the lamp anyway if not. Bridge the switch with a lead; if the lamp lights, the switch is the problem. Then the leads: nine times out of ten a clip is biting plastic. Voltmeter goes across a part; full battery volts across an open switch means that is your break. Ammeter goes in the loop, never across the battery. Your PAT indicator is this exact loop with an LED, a resistor and a sensor. Get this one right first.
visual_style: Whiteboard loop with a gap flashing; a lamp held to battery terminals; a lead bridging a switch; a clip on insulation circled; a voltmeter across and an ammeter in line.
mood: Reassuring and hands-on, like a lab partner who has done this before.
pacing: Loop, gap, battery test, lamp swap, bridge, clips, meters, PAT.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and practise finding a fault a friend hides in your circuit.
